decisions.story_title: Google publishes PoC exploit for AMD PSP code execution flaw CVE-2026-74127
decisions.reason: Security outlet's own report of a Google PoC for a CVSS 9.4 AMD PSP flaw and a Masterkey CVE-2018-8930 variant; no existing story covers this finding.

CVE-2026-74127.evidence: The post reports that Google published a proof-of-concept exploit for the AMD PSP code execution flaw, with no claim of exploitation in the wild.
